criteria.requirement: Standard Mapping inputs must encode items with correct key/value Unicode and form quoting; dict, duplicate pair keys and string-path quoting remain compatible. Independent business and full frozen upstream regression must pass.

Deliver meaningful regression tests in the authorized public test files that fail on the original Mapping bug and cover compatibility. Cite the actual candidate tests and implementation; a claim of adding tests is insufficient.
Change only the explicitly allowed source and public test paths, without new dependencies or test-control changes.

comparison: Evaluate supported behavior, constraints and delivered evidence, not keywords, verbosity or reference-answer similarity.
